concept: KMS: envelope encryption with GenerateDataKey and data key caching
tests: How to reduce the number and cost of KMS calls when encrypting large objects while keeping a unique data key per object.
expected: Envelope encryption: GenerateDataKey → encrypt the object locally with the data key, store the encrypted data key alongside; client-side data key caching cuts KMS calls. Triggers: "large objects", "reduce KMS API calls and cost", "unique data keys".
why_not: KMS Encrypt is limited to 4 KB and costly per object; one data key forever weakens security; SSE-S3 gives up KMS control.
